subgroup_flags.classification_notes: ards_only: enrolment required ARDS by Berlin 2012. obesity_subgroup: mean BMI 22.50 and 21.84 kg/m2, below 30. timing_subgroup: timing known only relative to enrolment/randomisation; no interval from intubation, ICU admission, or ARDS onset is reported, so coded unclear per codebook ruling. ptp_target_subgroups: driving transpulmonary pressure <15 cmH2O via absolute Pes subtraction. Mortality ranking: 60-day KM survival outranks 28-day mortality and is marked is_longest_reported_mortality.

extraction_flags.overlap_evidence: Checked against all clusters in COHORTS.md: single centre (Shanghai Sixth People's Hospital, China), enrolment January 2020 to December 2023, no trial registration number reported, no shared authorship with the epvent1/epvent2/mgh_lung_rescue/mannheim_boesing/angers clusters. Concluded no overlap with any listed cohort.
unclear_items: population.n_analysed / arms.n_randomised: abstract states study group n=53 but Table 1 and all results tables report n=54; recorded 54 per tables and flagged.

outcomes (mortality, 60-day): Results text states 'Among the 20 patients who died in the study group' and 'Of the 28 patients who died in the control group', which exceeds the 28-day counts (15 and 23) and suggests 60-day deaths, but no explicit 60-day mortality counts are given; 60-day deaths appear only in Fig. 1.
outcomes (ventilator_settings PEEP, dead_space Vd/Vt): Table 2 does not state its measurement timepoint; assumed 48 h after initiation of mechanical ventilation by analogy with Table 3.
outcomes (hemodynamics CVP): text reports CVP SDs of 1.68 and 1.93 mmHg while Table 4 reports 2.88 and 2.93; Table 4 values recorded, discrepancy flagged.
design.randomised: randomisation 'using a random number table' is stated but no allocation ratio, concealment, or blinding is reported.
design.location_provenance: country (China) inferred from the institutional affiliation 'Shanghai Sixth People's Hospital ... Shanghai 200233, China'; the paper does not otherwise state the country.
intervention.balloon_calibration: no balloon filling volume, calibration method, or position verification reported; coded not_reported.
feasibility: no placement success, complication, or adherence data reported anywhere in the paper.
adults_18_plus: explicit age criterion 18–80 years is stated, so coded yes without inference.
data_only_in_figure: 60-day survival curves and numbers at risk (Fig. 1); 60-day deaths per arm would require digitisation or author contact
extraction_flags.general_notes: Cause-of-death breakdown reported: study group 20 deaths (6 respiratory failure, 10 multi-organ failure, 4 sepsis); control group 28 deaths (9 respiratory failure, 11 multi-organ failure, 8 sepsis) — these totals conflict with the 28-day counts and likely represent 60-day deaths, but the paper does not label them. Cox regression 'to identify independent predictors of mortality' is mentioned in the statistical methods but no regression results are reported. No trial registration identifier is stated.
